2607.00716.title: Partial Skeleton Visibility for Action Recognition: A Constrained Field-of-View Approach
2607.00716.paper_summary: Skeleton-based action recognition has achieved remarkable success by exploiting joint coordinates and their topological connections, yet prevailing methods overwhelmingly assume complete and clean skeleton inputs. In real-world deployments, such as egocentric vision, crowded surveillance, wearable devices, or edge robotics, limited field-of-view (FoV) frequently causes substantial joint visibility dropout, leading to severe performance degradation that existing models are largely unprepared to handle. To bridge this critical yet underexplored gap, we introduce PartialVisGraph, a novel hypergraph framework tailored for robust skeleton action recognition under constrained FoV. We first construct highly expressive hypergraphs by introducing learnable virtual hyperedges that form a soft incidence matrix, capturing flexible high-order dependencies beyond conventional pairwise graphs. We then propose the Single-Head Sample-Adaptive Transformer, which adaptively aggregates joint features onto hyperedges while explicitly incorporating a visibility prior. This prior selectively gates information flow, preventing occluded or out-of-view joints from corrupting reliable feature propagation. We further establish rigorous evaluation protocols with realistic FoV simulation benchmarks on NTU RGB+D 60 and 120. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PartialVisGraph consistently achieves state-of-the-art accuracy under partial visibility, with gains of up to 68.8\% on subsets with severe FoV restrictions compared to recent strong baselines, while remaining superior on full-visibility settings. Our approach offers a principled and practical pathway toward deployable skeleton-based action understanding in unconstrained environments.
2607.00716.paper_summary_zh: 骨架基礎的動作識別透過利用關節坐標及其拓撲連結取得了顯著的成功，然而現有的方法大多假設輸入的骨架是完整且乾淨的。在現實世界的應用中，例如自我中心視覺、擁擠的監控、可穿戴設備或邊緣機器人，有限的視野（FoV）常常導致關節可見性大幅下降，進而導致嚴重的性能退化，而現有模型在這方面大多沒有準備好。為了填補這一關鍵但尚未充分探索的空白，我們引入了PartialVisGraph，一種針對受限FoV下穩健骨架動作識別的新型超圖框架。我們首先通過引入可學習的虛擬超邊來構建高度表達性的超圖，這些虛擬超邊形成一個柔性發生矩陣，捕捉超越傳統成對圖的靈活高階依賴關係。接著，我們提出了單頭樣本自適應Transformer，該Transformer自適應地將關節特徵聚合到超邊上，同時明確地納入可見性先驗。這一先驗選擇性地控制信息流，防止被遮擋或超出視野的關節損害可靠的特徵傳播。我們進一步建立了嚴謹的評估協議，並在NTU RGB+D 60和120上進行現實的FoV模擬基準測試。大量實驗表明，PartialVisGraph在部分可見性下持續達到最先進的準確率，在FoV限制嚴重的子集上相比於近期強基準獲得高達68.8\%的增益，同時在全可見性設置中仍然保持優越。我們的方法為在不受限環境中可部署的骨架基礎動作理解提供了一條原則性和實用的途徑。
